title: Committee of Supply – Head L (Ministry of the Environment and Water Resources)
what_it_is: Committee of Supply – Head L (Ministry of the Environment and Water Resources)

sections.label: Indonesia fire emissions estimates
sections.summary: Guido van der Werf's Global Fire Emissions Database estimates nearly 100,000 active fire detections in Indonesia last year, with daily emissions exceeding all US economic activity since September.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: According to estimates released by Guido van der Werf on the Global Fire Emissions Database, there had been nearly 100,000 active fire detections in Indonesia last year.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Since September last year, it has generated emissions exceeding the average daily emissions from all US economic activity, every day.

sections.label: Transboundary Haze Pollution Act enforcement
sections.summary: The passage asks what steps are being taken under the Transboundary Haze Pollution Act to prosecute and deter companies contributing to the haze.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: What steps are being taken under the Transboundary Haze Pollution Act to prosecute and deter errant companies which are contributing to the haze?

sections.label: Record high dengue cases
sections.summary: The National Environment Agency announced that Singapore may reach a record high in dengue cases this year.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: The National Environment Agency (NEA) has announced that we may reach a record high in the number of dengue cases this year.

sections.label: Extending smoking ban
sections.summary: The passage asks whether the Ministry intends to extend the smoking ban to more places to protect the public from second-hand smoke.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Does the Ministry intend to further extend the smoking ban to cover more places to safeguard the health of the public against second-hand smoke?

sections.label: New hawker centres by 2027
sections.summary: Hawker centres remain dear to Singaporeans and tourists, and 20 new hawker centres are expected to be ready by 2027.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: In our society, hawker centres still hold dear for many Singaporeans and even the tourists.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I am pleased to note that 20 new hawker centres are expected to be ready by 2027.

sections.label: Transboundary Haze Pollution Act tool
sections.summary: Since the Transboundary Haze Pollution Act passed in September 2014, NEA can hold companies responsible for haze pollution, and last year PSI stayed Unhealthy or Very Unhealthy for weeks due to fires in Sumatra and Central Kalimantan.

sentences.speaker: Asst Prof Mahdev Mohan (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Page: 47 Since the passage of the Transboundary Haze Pollution Act in September 2014, NEA has a new tool in its arsenal – to hold errant companies responsible for causing or contributing to haze pollution in Singapore, especially through unsustainable land-clearing in Indonesia and elsewhere.

sentences.speaker: Asst Prof Mahdev Mohan (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Last year, our Pollution Standards Index (PSI) remained at Unhealthy or Very Unhealthy levels for weeks on end due to fires that were started in Sumatra and Central Kalimantan.

sections.label: Transboundary haze investigation and notices
sections.summary: Asks what NEA's Director-General has done under Part III of the Transboundary Haze Pollution Act and seeks a status update on six preventive notices issued to Indonesian-domiciled companies.

sentences.speaker: Asst Prof Mahdev Mohan (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Beyond haze subsidies and haze preparedness, what action has the Director-General of Environmental Protection and NEA, as a whole, taken to investigate, address or mitigate transboundary haze pollution under Part III of the Transboundary Haze Pollution Act?

sentences.speaker: Asst Prof Mahdev Mohan (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: In particular, can we have a status update on the six preventive notices that were issued last year to companies domiciled in Indonesia?

sections.label: Changi Airport and reclaimed land levels
sections.summary: Reports that the new Changi Airport was built on higher ground against sea-level rise, and that the minimum level for newly reclaimed land rose in 2011.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
sentences.text: In late 2014, it was reported that the new Changi Airport was being built on higher ground to guard against rising sea levels and that it would be able to withstand more than the projected 18-inch or 46-centimetre rise in sea levels.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
sentences.text: Separately, the minimum level for newly reclaimed land went up in 2011 to 2.25 metres above the highest recorded tide from 1.25 metres.

sections.label: Singapore temperature, sea level, COP21 pledge
sections.summary: States Singapore's annual mean temperature rose from 26.6°C to 27.7°C, sea level rose 1.2 to 1.7 millimetres per year, and Singapore supported COP21 and pledged emissions cuts.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: As a small city-state on an island, Singapore is not insulated from the impact of climate change.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: It has been reported that from 1972 to 2014, the annual mean temperature has increased from 26.6°C to 27.7°C.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: The mean sea level in Page: 49 the Straits of Singapore has also increased at the rate of 1.2 millimetre to 1.7 millimetre per year in the period 1975 to 2009.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Singapore was supportive of the historic COP21 climate deal last year, declaring its intention to reduce Emissions Intensity by 36% from 2005 levels by 2030 and stabilise emissions with the aim of peaking around 2030.

sections.label: 2015 haze losses estimate
sections.summary: Minister Masagos said the 2015 haze caused an estimated $700 million of losses.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development and Acting Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim)
sentences.text: Minister Masagos mentioned that the haze in 2015 caused us an estimated $700 million of losses.

sections.label: Projected 2016 dengue cases
sections.summary: The Government reported in February that 2016 dengue cases may exceed 30,000, higher than the 2013 record of 22,170 cases.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: In February, the Government reported that the number of dengue cases in 2016 may exceed 30,000, higher than the record of 22,170 cases in 2013.

sections.label: Wolbachia funding for dengue
sections.summary: The Minister said $3 million is being set aside to develop the Wolbachia bacteria to fight dengue over the next three years.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: The Minister has also said that $3 million is being put aside to develop the Wolbachia bacteria to fight dengue over the next three years.

sections.label: Dengue cases expected to rise
sections.summary: NEA announced that a higher number of dengue cases compared to last year is likely.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: NEA announced that we are likely to see a higher number of dengue cases compared to last year.

sections.label: Singapore water demand and supply
sections.summary: Singapore's water demand is 400 million gallons per day, expected to double by 2061, when the Malaysia agreement ends.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheng Li Hui
sentences.text: Singapore's current demand for water is 400 	million gallons per day and it is expected to double to 800 	million gallons per day by 2061 due to population increases and growing commerce and industry needs.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheng Li Hui
sentences.text: Our 99-year water agreement with Malaysia will end in 2061.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheng Li Hui
sentences.text: Currently, the Linggiu Reservoir's water level is hovering around 43% due the recent dry weather.

sections.label: Three parts of water strategy
sections.summary: The current water strategy has three parts: maximise collection, water treatment and desalination.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Our current water strategy has three parts: maximise collection, water treatment and desalination.

sections.label: E-waste recycling rate in 2015
sections.summary: The Ministry of Environment and Water Resources reported that less than 1% of e-waste was recycled in 2015.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: According to the Ministry of Environment and Water Resources, quite disappointingly, only less than 1% of our e-waste was recycled in 2015.

sections.label: E-waste produced and national system
sections.summary: Sixty million kilogrammes of e-waste are produced yearly, and NEA is looking into a national collection and recycling system.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: Sixty million kilogrammes of e-waste are produced every year, of which only a small portion is collected by community e-waste recycling programmes.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: I understand that NEA is looking into the option of having a national system to collect, recycle and handle e-waste.

sections.label: Food waste recycling pilot launch
sections.summary: NEA announced a two-year onsite food waste recycling pilot at two hawker centres in Ang Mo Kio and Tiong Bahru.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Recently, NEA announced the launch of a two-year onsite food waste recycling pilot at two hawker centres in Ang Mo Kio and Tiong Bahru.

sections.label: Market food waste pilot extension
sections.summary: Ang Mo Kio and Tiong Bahru markets produce an estimated 1,800 tonnes of food waste a year, and NEA could extend pilots to nearby private coffee shops, food courts and grocery stores.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: The Ang Mo Kio and Tiong Bahru markets together produce an estimated 1,800 tonnes of food waste a year but the markets occupy a central place in the town centres and NEA could extend the pilot projects to a wider catchment area to cover nearby private coffee shops, food courts and grocery stores.

sections.label: F&B cluster recycling pilots
sections.summary: NEA should begin simultaneous pilot projects to encourage food waste recycling at clusters of F&B joints such as shophouse rows or shopping malls.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Second, NEA should begin simultaneous pilot projects to encourage food waste recycling at clusters of F&B joints, such as those in shophouse rows or shopping malls across the city.

sections.label: HDB block recycling bins
sections.summary: NEA provides a blue recycling bin at the common area next to every HDB block under the National Recycling Programme to encourage more households to recycle.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheng Li Hui
sentences.text: NEA provides a blue recycling bin at the common area next to every HDB block under the National Recycling Programme (NRP) to encourage more households to recycle.

sections.label: Singapore food waste statistics
sections.summary: In 2014 Singapore produced 788,600 tonnes of food waste, about 146 kilogrammes per person, and food waste increased by 48% in the past 10 years.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu
sentences.text: In 2014, Singapore produced 788,600 tonnes of food waste, which means that each person discarded about 146 kilogrammes of food over the course of a year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu
sentences.text: Food waste in Singapore has increased by 48% in the past 10 years.

sections.label: Rodent surveillance and Rat Attack
sections.summary: NEA implements an integrated rodent surveillance and vector control programme, over 35,000 rodent burrows were detected and treated from January to November 2014, and NEA brought back the Rat Attack programme with the Town Councils.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu
sentences.text: In the Ministry's reply to my Parliamentary Question last year, I note that NEA implements an integrated rodent surveillance and vector control programme and that from January 2014 to November 2014, over 35,000 rodent burrows were detected and treated.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu
sentences.text: I also understand that NEA has brought back the Rat Attack programme that is administered in partnership with the Town Page: 55 Councils.

sections.label: Community Volunteers and littering offenders
sections.summary: The amendment expands the Community Volunteer scheme to let NEA appoint individuals as CVs to assist with enforcement, and asks how many people were caught littering in the past year and their profiles.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh
sentences.text: With the amendment to expand the Community Volunteer (CV) scheme to allow NEA to appoint individuals as CVs, we will have more people to assist with enforcement on the ground.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh
sentences.text: In addition, how many people have been caught for littering in the past year and what are the profiles of these typical offenders?

sections.label: Not-for-profit hawker centres experience
sections.summary: Two hawker centres run under the not-for-profit model are cited, and the Minister is asked how the experience has been and what learning points apply to the next 18 new hawker centres.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa
sentences.text: They were Hougang Ci Yuan Hawker Centre operated by Fei Siong Food Management and Bukit Panjang Hawker Centre run by NTUC Foodfare.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa
sentences.text: These two hawker centres were run under the new "not-for-profit" model.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa
sentences.text: Can the Minister update how the experience has been and whether there are good learning points to apply for the Page: 56 next 18 new hawker centres?

sections.label: Barrier to entry for hawkers
sections.summary: The question asks whether NEA would consider further lowering the barrier to entry for young would-be hawkers and having a new hawker assistance scheme or programme for first-time hawkers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa
sentences.text: Would NEA consider further lowering the barrier to entry for young would-be hawkers and have a new hawker assistance scheme or programme to help first-time hawkers?

sections.label: Ministry smoking prohibition policy goal
sections.summary: The Ministry's long-term policy goal is to prohibit smoking at all public places except designated smoking points or areas, with NEA moving from a prohibitive list to a positive list.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: The long-term policy goal of the Ministry is to prohibit smoking at all public places, except designated smoking points or areas.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: NEA's goal is to move the policy from a prohibitive list to a positive list.

sections.label: ABC Waters Programme tenth year
sections.summary: The ABC Waters Programme, now in its 10th year, aims to integrate drains, canals and reservoirs with the surrounding environment to create clean streams, rivers and lakes with community spaces, and 32 projects have been completed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: Having seen the old canal before the implementation of the programme, I can see the amazing transformation it has undergone and how it has turned the area into a community space, which is well-used.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: That is the goal of the ABC Waters Programme. "By integrating the drains, canals and reservoirs with the surrounding environment in a holistic way, the ABC Waters Programme aims to create beautiful and clean streams, rivers and lakes with postcard-pretty community spaces for all to enjoy." We are now in our 10th year of the programme and I understand that over the last 10 years, 32 ABC Waters projects have been completed across the island.

sections.label: Tightened vehicle and industry emissions
sections.summary: Standards for industrial emissions were tightened and the Early Turnover Scheme extended to Euro II and Euro III diesel commercial vehicles, while all new petrol vehicles must be Euro VI compliant from September 2017 and new diesel vehicles from January 2018.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Last year, we tightened standards for emissions from industries and extended the Early Turnover Scheme to include Euro II and Euro III diesel commercial vehicles to incentivise the replacement of older and more pollutive commercial vehicles sooner.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Emission standards for new motor vehicles are also being tightened – all new petrol motor vehicles will have to be Euro VI – compliant from September 2017 and all new diesel motor vehicles from January 2018.

sections.label: Tighter motorcycle emission standards
sections.summary: Emission standards for new motorcycles will be tightened to Euro IV in phases: for large motorcycles above 200 cc from 1 January 2018 and small motorcycles of 200 cc and below from 1 January 2020.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: We need to raise their emission standards in step with improvements in technology.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: We will, therefore, be tightening the emission standards for new motorcycles to the latest Euro IV standards.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: This will be done in phases: for large motorcycles above 200 cc from 1 January 2018, and for small motorcycles of 200 cc and below from 1 January 2020.

sections.label: Diesel vehicle pollution study
sections.summary: A study of pollution from diesel vehicles in Singapore will be conducted.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: To do this, we will conduct a study of pollution from diesel vehicles in Singapore.

sections.label: ASEAN haze monitoring system
sections.summary: Singapore led development of the ASEAN Sub-Regional Haze Monitoring System to increase transparency and accountability of companies responsible for fires.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Singapore has led the development of the ASEAN Sub-Regional Haze Monitoring System which aims to increase transparency and accountability of errant companies responsible for the fires.

sections.label: Firefighting assistance to Indonesia
sections.summary: Since 2005 Singapore has offered Indonesia assistance to fight fires, worked with Muaro-Jambi Regency from 2007 to 2011, and awaits Indonesia's response on renewing collaboration.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Since 2005, we have been offering them assistance to fight fires and will continue to do so.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: We had also worked with the Muaro-Jambi Regency in Jambi Province on capacity building projects to deal with land and forest fires from 2007 to 2011.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: We have since offered to renew this collaboration under a proposed Memorandum of Understanding and are awaiting Indonesia's response.

sections.label: NEA notices to companies
sections.summary: After the 2015 haze, NEA sent Preventive Measures Notices to six Indonesia-based companies and served notices on APPCL and a foreign Director under the THPA.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Arising from the 2015 haze episodes, NEA sent Preventive Measures Notices under section 9 of the THPA to six companies based in Indonesia, requesting that they take immediate measures to mitigate fires and develop plans to prevent their recurrence.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: In addition, NEA served a Notice under section 10 of the THPA on Asia Pulp & Paper Company Ltd (APPCL)'s office in Singapore to seek information on its subsidiaries in Singapore and Indonesia, as well as measures taken by its Indonesian suppliers to put out fires in their concessions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Of the four companies based in Indonesia that did not respond, NEA has recently served Notices under sections 10 and 11 of the THPA on a foreign Director when he was in Singapore.

sections.label: Government green printing paper
sections.summary: From third quarter 2016 the Government will procure printing paper products carrying the Singapore Green Label.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: The Government will do its part as a consumer as well.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: I am pleased to announce that from third quarter 2016, the Government will take the lead and procure printing paper products that carry the Singapore Green Label, an indication that the supplier practises sustainable forestry management.

sections.label: Indonesian fires emissions comparison
sections.summary: Based on the Global Fire Emissions Database, fires in Indonesia produced more emissions per day than the entire US economy.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: As mentioned by Er Dr Lee Bee Wah, based on the Global Fire Emissions Database, the fires in Indonesia produced more emissions per day than the entire US economy.

sections.label: Singapore climate change response
sections.summary: Singapore has an ambitious emission intensity target and an Inter-Ministerial Committee on Climate Change is formulating the national response.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Although Singapore only contributes 0.11% of global emissions, we are no less serious and have an ambitious target to reduce emission intensity.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: The Inter-Ministerial Committee on Climate Change, under the leadership of Deputy Prime Minister Teo, is formulating our national response to fight climate change to meet our obligations and prepare for its impact.

sections.label: Solar energy deployment target
sections.summary: Singapore aims to increase solar energy deployment to at least 350 megawatt peak by 2020.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Although Singapore has limited alternative energy options, we can do more in terms of adopting solar energy.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: We have made progress towards increasing the deployment of solar energy to at least 350 megawatt peak by 2020.

sections.label: Projected sea level and temperature rise
sections.summary: By the last decades of this century, sea level, temperatures and rainfall in Singapore are projected to change.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: By the last few decades of this century, the sea level is projected to rise by between 0.25 metres and 0.76 metres; temperatures may increase by 1.4 degree Celsius to 4.6 degree Celsius; and Singapore will experience more intense rainfall.

sections.label: Coastal protection at Changi and Nicoll
sections.summary: Hard structures protect the coastline where practical, and Changi Coast Road and Nicoll Drive are being raised by mid-2016.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Currently, where it is practical, we have made hard structures to protect our coastline.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: We are raising a stretch of Changi Coast Road and Nicoll Drive to guard against sea level rise and we expect this to be completed by mid-2016.

sections.label: Dengue cases may exceed 2013 record
sections.summary: Without immediate measures, cases this year may exceed 30,000, higher than the 22,170 cases in 2013.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: As Mr Liang Eng Hwa and Ms Sylvia Lim pointed out, unless immediate measures are taken together, the number of cases this year may exceed 30,000, higher than the record of 22,170 cases in 2013.

sections.label: Dengue prevention volunteers expansion
sections.summary: There are more than 5,800 Dengue Prevention Volunteers, and 5,000 more will be trained this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Page: 63 I am glad to see the strong community response in the effort against dengue – we have more than 5,800 Dengue Prevention Volunteers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: We need more of them and will train 5,000 more volunteers this year.

sections.label: islandwide inspections in first quarter
sections.summary: About 350,000 inspections were carried out islandwide in the first three months of this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: In the first three months this year, they carried out about 350,000 inspections islandwide; just the first three months.

sections.label: Linggiu Reservoir water level drop
sections.summary: Drier weather lowered Linggiu Reservoir from about 80% at the start of 2015 to 36.9%, and it decreases without rain.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: The drier weather these couple of years saw the water level in Linggiu Reservoir drop to historic lows, from about 80% at the start of 2015 to 36.9% as we speak, and decreasing when there is no rain.

sections.label: second Changi NEWater Factory
sections.summary: A second NEWater Factory at Changi will be completed by the end of the year, the fifth plant, producing 50 million gallons per day.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: A second NEWater Factory at Changi will be completed by the end of the year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: This will be our fifth NEWater plant and will be able to produce 50 million gallons per day of NEWater.

sections.label: low-energy desalination technology development
sections.summary: PUB is working with industry to develop and test low-energy desalination technologies, including an Evoqua demonstration plant using electrochemical processes that could halve desalination energy needs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: This is vital and PUB is working closely with the industry to develop and test low-energy desalination technologies, one of which is a demonstration plant with Evoqua using electrochemical processes to remove salt from water.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: This technology has the potential to halve the energy requirement for desalination.

sections.label: islandwide drainage improvement programme
sections.summary: An ongoing islandwide drainage improvement programme has projects at 101 locations to be completed in three years, with work starting at another 30 this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: We have an ongoing islandwide drainage improvement programme to increase the capacity of our "pathway" drains.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: There are ongoing projects at 101 locations islandwide to be completed in the next three years; and, this year, we start work at another 30 locations.

sections.label: unaccounted-for-water and leak rate
sections.summary: Singapore's unaccounted-for-water is maintained at around 5% and its leak rate at about six leaks per 100 kilometres each year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Through these efforts, Singapore's unaccounted-for-water is maintained at around 5% and our leak rate is at about six leaks per 100 kilometres each year.

sections.label: Daily water use per person
sections.summary: Water use fell from 165 litres per person per day in 2003 to 150 litres in 2014, then rebounded to 151 litres last year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: In 2014, we used 150 litres per person per day, down from 165 litres in 2003.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: However, this rebounded to 151 litres last year.

sections.label: Washing machine tick rating
sections.summary: A 4-tick rating for washing machines will be introduced.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: First, we will introduce a 4-tick rating for washing machines.

sections.label: Phasing out 0-tick taps
sections.summary: 0-tick taps and mixers will be phased out, allowing only those with 1-tick or more to be sold or supplied.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Second, we will phase out 0-tick taps and mixers and allow only taps and mixers with 1-tick or more to be sold or supplied.

sections.label: E-waste hazardous substance restrictions
sections.summary: From 2017, hazardous substances will be restricted in six types of electrical and electronic equipment, including mobile phones, refrigerators and washing machines.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: Singapore generates more than 60,000 tonnes of e-waste every year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: As pointed out by Dr Chia Shi-Lu and Mr Louis Ng, e-waste may contain valuable materials, but also small amounts of hazardous substances which can cause pollution and affect human health.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: We have studied the upstream controls of hazardous substances in electrical and electronic equipment and I would like to update that, from 2017, we will restrict hazardous substances in six types of electrical and electronic equipment.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: They are mobile phones, mobile computers, refrigerators, air conditioners, panel TVs and washing machines.

sections.label: Phasing out mercury-added batteries
sections.summary: Mercury-added batteries exceeding five ppm by weight will be prohibited from manufacture, import and export by 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: While the vast majority of batteries sold in Singapore do not contain mercury, a very small number do.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: We plan to phase out mercury-added batteries, including button-cell batteries, which contain mercury exceeding five parts per million (ppm) by weight.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: The manufacture, import and export of all non-compliant mercury-added batteries will be prohibited by 2018.

sections.label: Singapore food waste generated
sections.summary: In 2015, Singapore generated almost 800,000 tonnes of food waste, or 10% of all waste.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: In 2015, Singapore generated almost 800,000 tonnes of food waste, or 10% of all waste.

sections.label: Community litter picking day
sections.summary: Ten thousand participants from over 80 community groups picked up more than 7,000 kilogrammes of litter in one day.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: Ten thousand participants from over 80 community groups came together and picked up more than 7,000 kilogrammes of litter during that single day.

sections.label: Bill allows non-NGO CVs
sections.summary: A Bill was passed to let non-NGO individuals meeting criteria and training become CVs, who advise but do not issue tickets.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: In response to feedback, we have passed a Bill to allow individuals who are not necessarily members of any NGO but meet the stringent selection criteria and fulfil the requisite training, to become a CV.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: The CV's primary role is to encourage the public to take responsibility for the environment and they do not issue tickets to offenders.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: So far, our CVs have engaged more than 2,500 potential offenders and I am pleased to hear that more than 99% of them, in fact, heeded the advice of the CVs.

sections.label: Smoking ban in reservoirs, parks
sections.summary: From 1 June 2016, smoking will be prohibited in reservoirs and more than 400 parks, including neighbourhood parks.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: We will continue our work towards a smoke-free Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: I am glad to inform Er Dr Lee and Mr Louis Ng that from 1 June 2016, smoking will be prohibited in reservoirs and more than 400 parks, including neighbourhood parks within residential estates and those under JTC.

sections.label: Rat burrows found in 2015
sections.summary: In 2015, about 43,000 rat burrows were found.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: In 2015, about 43,000 rat burrows were found.

sections.label: Twenty new hawker centres
sections.summary: Twenty new hawker centres will be built by 2027, with several completed or ready in coming years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: We have announced that we will be building 20 new hawker centres by 2027.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: I am pleased to note that the hawker centres at Bukit Panjang and Hougang have been completed and the centre at Our Tampines Hub will be ready by the end of this year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: Another four hawker centres at Pasir Ris, Woodlands, Yishun and Jurong West will be completed next year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: One of them will be located at the site of the old Fernvale Point; the location of the other hawker centre at Sengkang will be announced, once ready.

sections.label: Hawker cost study findings
sections.summary: A study of 1,000 hawkers found rentals were 12% of total cost, with raw materials 59% and manpower 17%.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: The study looked at 1,000 hawkers and found that rentals made up only 12% of the hawkers' total cost.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: The larger components were raw materials and manpower at 59% and 17% of total cost respectively.

sections.label: Training and support for hawkers
sections.summary: New hawkers can be taught cooking, food hygiene and business management, complemented by productivity and cost measures like centralised dishwashing or bulk buying.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: Individuals who decide to enter the hawker trade can be taught how to cook and to maintain proper food hygiene and skills in business management.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: This may be complemented by measures to help hawkers improve productivity and mitigate cost increases, for example, through centralised services for dishwashing, or bulk buying and preparation of raw ingredients.

sections.label: ABC Waters projects completion
sections.summary: The Siglap Canal decking example is cited, and about 20 more ABC Waters projects are expected to be completed over the next five years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: An example is the ABC Waters project at Siglap Canal near Kampong Kembangan Community Club, where a 150-metre section of the canal was decked over to increase accessibility to the Community Club (CC) and to provide communal space for social enjoyment.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: Page: 72 Er Dr Lee and Mr Louis Ng have asked about our plans moving forward.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: I am pleased to share that we can look towards the completion of about 20 more projects over the next five years.

sections.label: Notices served on APPCL
sections.summary: Maps from sources like WRI cannot be used alone, and Notices were served on Asia Pulp & Paper Company Limited based on hotspots and calculated plumes.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
sentences.text: Is it time for her to announce where those projects are and is there one in Yishun?

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: We get the detailed maps currently from different sources, like from World Resource Institute (WRI), but we cannot proceed on these maps alone.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: In the case of one of the companies that we have given the Notice, Asia Pulp & Paper Company Limited (APPCL) particularly, they have published their maps.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Therefore, based on where the hotspots were found, and the plumes we calculated that would have gotten to Singapore, we have served them Notices.

sections.label: Directors of named companies
sections.summary: Directors named in these companies will be taken to task.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: The directors who are named in these companies will be taken to task.

sections.label: Twenty projects already confirmed
sections.summary: The 20 projects to be completed in the next five years are already confirmed.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Having said that, first, let me say that, actually, the 20 projects to be completed in the next five years are already confirmed.

sections.label: Terminated MOU with Indonesian administration
sections.summary: The MOU cannot continue because the last Indonesian administration terminated it, and the question asks if this is a lower priority than vector control.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim
sentences.text: Is it because it is considered, in a sense, a lower priority strategy when compared to vector control?

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: We are as disappointed that we cannot continue with the MOU.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: For some reason, within the Indonesian administration, in fact, the last administration terminated that MOU.

sections.label: Training in fire mitigation
sections.summary: Speaker says they are keen to train people on the ground in fire mitigation and reporting the onset of haze.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: On our part, we are very keen to do this because that will put people on the ground, their people on the ground, to be trained in fire mitigation, in reporting the onset of haze.

sections.label: Fernvale hawker centre and rentals
sections.summary: Senior Minister of State shared a new hawker centre will be built in Fernvale, Sengkang, and 45% of bidders got stalls at $1,500 and below monthly.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh
sentences.text: The Senior Minister of State shared that there will be a new hawker centre to be built in Fernvale, Sengkang.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh
sentences.text: She also shared that since the removal of the reserve price, 45% of those who bidded to rent the hawker stalls got the stalls at $1,500 and below per month.

sections.label: Hawker stall rentals below reserve
sections.summary: Speaker said 45% got stalls below the reserve-market rent, and some stalls have $1 rental but the number of single-digit ones is unknown.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Regarding the rentals, I said that 45% got the stalls below the reserve-market rent.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: There are actually stalls with rental of $1 but I do not have the figure of how many are single-digit.

sections.label: PUB framework for ABC designs
sections.summary: PUB is looking at a framework of guidelines on ABC programme design and concepts to encourage developers and land agencies to incorporate them.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: PUB is also looking at a framework to work with developers, land agencies and so on − a framework of guidelines on the ABC programme design and concepts to encourage private developers, as well as land agencies, to incorporate these designs and concepts into their development.

sections.label: Extension of smoking prohibition in parks
sections.summary: About 30 NParks parks already prohibit smoking; the additional 400-odd parks include neighbourhood parks, JTC Corp parks and NParks-managed parks in private estates.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Regarding smoking prohibition, there are already about 30 parks under NParks where smoking is prohibited.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The additional 400-odd parks which will be covered by the extension of the smoking prohibition include neighbourhood parks within Town Council-managed areas, parks under JTC Corp and NParks-managed parks in private residential estates.

sections.label: No Smoking signages and wet markets
sections.summary: Signages will be put up at no-smoking parks with land agencies and Town Councils, prohibition may be extended based on feedback, and many wet markets do not do well.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: For those parks where smoking is already prohibited, there are "No Smoking" signages put up and we will be working with the land agencies, Town Councils and so on to get them to put up the proper signages so that people know that it is a "No Smoking" park.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We will continue to work with relevant stakeholders, land agencies, Town Councils and so on, as well as based on public feedback, to look at progressively extending our smoking prohibition to beyond what we already have, but please remember there are already 32,000 premises plus the additional ones where we will be extending our smoking ban.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Regarding markets, it is true that many existing wet markets, unless they are regional and they serve not just the neighbourhood but the region, do not do well.
